meta.name: visual-qa
meta.description: MUST USE after building/changing any UI or when asked whether a page, component, or TUI looks right. Rigorous visual QA across web/page, terminal, and paginated-document surfaces. Prefer browser:control-in-app-browser for unauthenticated browser/page QA in Codex, then Playwright/agent-browser/dev-browser. Captures screenshot/TUI evidence with bundled diff scripts, runs design-system/functional and visual-fidelity/CJK reviewer passes, then synthesizes a good/bad verdict. Triggers: visual QA, screenshot/pixel diff, UI looks wrong, reference fidelity, design system check, responsive check, CJK text clipping, TUI alignment, box-drawing drift, PDF page check, deck review, blank or near-empty page, wrong page break.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 检查网页、终端和文档的视觉效果,标出异常
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果每次改完页面都担心显示效果
copy.tagline_en: Verify UI visuals on web, terminal, and documents via screenshot diffs.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you change UI often and worry about visual regressions.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会在你构建或改动任何界面后,检查页面、终端界面或文档排版是否正常。它会截图或抓取终端画面,用脚本对比,再让两个独立检查员分别核对设计规范和视觉效果,最后给出好/坏结论。
howto.when: 在构建或改动任何界面之后,以及当用户询问页面、组件或终端界面看起来是否正确时触发;用户提到「视觉检查」「界面不对」「设计系统」等词也会触发。

say.text: 我刚改完登录页,帮我做一次视觉检查。
say.note: Claude 会截图并对比设计,给出好/坏结论。

say.text: 检查这个 PDF 的每一页排版有没有问题。
say.note: Claude 会把每页渲染成图片逐一核对。

say.text: 终端里的表格边框是不是没对齐?帮我看看。
say.note: Claude 会抓取终端画面并检查对齐。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude reviews any UI you build or change (web pages, terminal UIs, documents) by capturing screenshots/frames, diffing them with scripts, running two independent reviewer passes, and returning a good/bad verdict.
howto.when_en: Triggered after building or changing any UI, or when the user asks whether a page, component, or TUI looks right; also on keywords like 'visual QA', 'looks wrong', or 'design system'.

say_en.text: I just changed the login page. Do a visual QA pass on it.
say_en.note: Claude screenshots it and returns a good/bad verdict.

say_en.text: Check every page of this PDF for layout problems.
say_en.note: Claude renders each page to an image and reviews them.

say_en.text: Does the table border in the terminal misalign? Take a look.
say_en.note: Claude captures the terminal screen and checks alignment.
